output_list.criticism: The 'transfer' function does not check for overflow of the balanceOf sender, allowing an attacker to make the balance of the attacker become a very large value.
The 'transferFrom' function does not check for overflow of the balanceOf sender, allowing an attacker to make the balance of the attacker become a very large value.
The 'generateTokens' function does not check for overflow of the balanceOf owner, allowing an attacker to mint tokens out of thin air.
The 'destroyTokens' function does not check for overflow of the balanceOf user, allowing an attacker to destroy tokens of a user.
The 'changeOwner' function does not check if the new owner is a contract, allowing attackers to set a contract as the owner, and then drain funds.
